title: The 9 Best No-Code App Builders in 2026 (AI-First and Classic, Tested)
summary: Tested every serious no-code app builder in 2026. Split by AI-first vs classic visual. Ranked by pricing, ownership, and real use cases. Real screenshots and live pricing.
body_markdown: AI-first apps with clean code export (Blink, Lovable, Bolt) scale as well as hand-coded apps — you deploy to standard infrastructure. Replit apps scale with Replit infrastructure (fine up to moderate load, pricier at scale). Bubble apps historically struggle past thousands of concurrent users without expensive enterprise tiers. Softr and Glide inherit limits from Airtable/Sheets pricing and row limits. For apps you expect to grow past a few thousand users, pick an AI-first tool with clean export.
